name: scigantic-surechembl
summary: SureChEMBL patent chemistry from Python: compounds by id, name, SMILES or InChIKey, structure search, patents by compound, Solr full-text search, full patent documents with their extracted chemistry, DOCDB families, ChEMBL/PubChem/DrugBank/ChEBI/PDB/BindingDB cross-references via UniChem, the bulk parquet releases read in place from EBI with DuckDB, and joins into scigantic-chembl, scigantic-bindingdb and scigantic-pubchem. No mirror, no download, no key.
author: Scigantic
